lines.zh: 我沿着糖草爬，黏液拉出一条线。
lines.en: I crawl along candy grass, trailing a line of slime.

lines.zh: 壳一圈红一圈白，走起来像糖。
lines.en: My shell rings red and white; moving, I look like candy.

lines.zh: 一次挪半寸，急也急不来。
lines.en: Half an inch per move; there is no hurrying this.

lines.zh: 黏液在身后发亮，薄荷味很淡。
lines.en: Slime shines behind me with a faint mint smell.

lines.zh: 我过石阶，壳底磨出细细的声。
lines.en: Crossing stone steps, my shell grinds a thin sound.

lines.zh: 糖果维度的地面有点黏脚。
lines.en: The ground of Candyland is sticky underfoot.

lines.zh: 我把身体伸出去，再慢慢拖壳。
lines.en: I stretch my body out, then drag the shell along.

lines.zh: 黏液留下的路，我明天还认得。
lines.en: I will know tomorrow the road my slime left.

lines.zh: 别催我，蜗牛的速度不谈判。
lines.en: Do not rush me; snail speed is not negotiable.

lines.zh: 我绕着糖果树转，找落下的碎屑。
lines.en: I circle the candy tree, hunting fallen crumbs.

lines.zh: 两只触角先探路，壳随后跟上。
lines.en: Two tentacles scout ahead; the shell follows.

lines.zh: 走一步，黏液就凉一下。
lines.en: Each step cools the slime a little.

lines.zh: 红白相间，是我留给路上的记号。
lines.en: Red and white are the marks I leave on the road.

lines.zh: 从叶背爬到叶面，花了一上午。
lines.en: Leaf underside to topside took me all morning.

lines.zh: 我爬过一块糖砖，留下银线。
lines.en: I cross a candy brick and leave a silver thread.

lines.zh: 拐角处我停了一下，换个方向。
lines.en: At the corner I pause, then change direction.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，只留两根触角。
lines.en: I pull into my shell, leaving two tentacles out.

lines.zh: 壳里的螺旋转了三圈，我数得清。
lines.en: The spiral in my shell turns three times; I have counted.

lines.zh: 我贴着糖草不动，慢慢嚼叶子。
lines.en: I cling to a candy blade and chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 薄荷味从壳里透出来，是甜的。
lines.en: Mint seeps from my shell, and it is sweet.

lines.zh: 太阳晒到壳上，暖得像刚出锅。
lines.en: Sun on my shell is as warm as fresh candy.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，黏液在脚边积成小点。
lines.en: I stay still, and slime beads up around my foot.

lines.zh: 有蚂蚁爬上我的壳，我懒得理。
lines.en: An ant climbs my shell; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 壳口朝下，这样水不容易进去。
lines.en: Shell mouth down keeps the water out.

lines.zh: 壳沿朝着光，我一整天没挪窝。
lines.en: Shell rim to the light, I have not moved all day.

lines.zh: 红白的花纹在光下像糖纸。
lines.en: My red-white pattern looks like candy wrapping in the light.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有咀嚼声，不是我。
lines.en: I hear chewing far off, and it is not me.

lines.zh: 我把头探出来，又缩回去。
lines.en: I poke my head out, then pull it back in.

lines.zh: 壳有点重，可它替我挡了很多。
lines.en: My shell is heavy, but it has taken many blows for me.

lines.zh: 我在等一场甜甜的雨。
lines.en: I am waiting for a sweet rain.

lines.zh: 我把触角收短，藏在壳沿下。
lines.en: I draw my tentacles short, tucked under the shell rim.

lines.zh: 风带来糖浆味，我慢慢抬头。
lines.en: The wind brings syrup, and I lift my head slowly.

lines.zh: 两根触角朝你转过来，一起来。
lines.en: Both tentacles turn toward you at once.

lines.zh: 你比我高太多了，我得抬头看。
lines.en: You are so much taller; I have to look up.

lines.zh: 我看见了，就慢慢把眼收回去。
lines.en: Having seen enough, I slowly retract my eyes.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上沾了糖霜。
lines.en: There is frosting on your boots.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，除非你抬手。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you unless your hand lifts.

lines.zh: 你挡住太阳，我壳上就凉了。
lines.en: You block the sun, and my shell goes cool.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一片特别大的叶子。
lines.en: I see you as an especially large leaf.

lines.zh: 别晃手指，我的眼会跟着转。
lines.en: Do not wiggle a finger; my eyes will follow it.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，没有薄荷。
lines.en: You do not smell of mint at all.

lines.zh: 我伸出触角，碰了碰空气里的你。
lines.en: I reach a tentacle and touch your shape in the air.

lines.zh: 你的影子一动，我的壳就偏一点。
lines.en: When your shadow moves, my shell tilts a little.

lines.zh: 看够了，我又开始啃叶子。
lines.en: Done looking, I go back to chewing leaves.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道细缝，黏液渗出来。
lines.en: A thin crack opens and slime seeps through.

lines.zh: 二十五点生命，掉一点都心疼。
lines.en: Twenty-five points of life; each one hurts to lose.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，你敲吧。
lines.en: I pull in; go ahead and knock.

lines.zh: 壳碎了，红白的碎片落在地上。
lines.en: My shell breaks and red-white shards fall.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的触角了，很疼。
lines.en: You stepped on my tentacle, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我流出来的黏液，比血还多。
lines.en: More slime than blood comes out of me.

lines.zh: 别砸了，壳里的肉在发抖。
lines.en: Stop hitting; the flesh inside is trembling.

lines.zh: 我往糖草里钻，壳还是露着。
lines.en: I burrow into the candy grass, shell still showing.

lines.zh: 这一下，我半年都长不回来。
lines.en: This damage will take half a year to regrow.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我连薄荷味都淡了。
lines.en: In pain, even my mint smell fades.

lines.zh: 你手里有糖，我的触角先竖起来。
lines.en: You hold sugar, and my tentacles rise first.

lines.zh: 薄荷糖的味道一飘，我就挪了。
lines.en: One whiff of peppermint and I start moving.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，黏液拖了很长。
lines.en: I follow you, dragging a long ribbon of slime.

lines.zh: 再往前一点，让我闻到甜味。
lines.en: A little closer, let me smell the sweetness.

lines.zh: 糖块比叶子好吃多了。
lines.en: Candy tastes far better than leaves.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我跟一步，很公平。
lines.en: You step back, I step forward; that is fair.

lines.zh: 我可以为了糖爬完整个维度。
lines.en: I would cross the whole dimension for sugar.

lines.zh: 别收回去，我的壳还没到。
lines.en: Do not put it away; my shell has not arrived.

lines.zh: 甜味停在半空，我就停在半路。
lines.en: The sweetness hangs; so do I, halfway there.

lines.zh: 你这块糖，闻着像我的壳。
lines.en: That candy of yours smells like my shell.

lines.zh: 我把头伸得很长，只为了舔一口。
lines.en: I stretch my neck far out just to lick it once.

lines.zh: 食物放在地上，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Put the food down and I will help myself.

lines.zh: 糖霜沾在嘴边，我不擦。
lines.en: Frosting on my mouth; I do not wipe it.

lines.zh: 你要是边走边撒糖，我能跟一天。
lines.en: Scatter sugar as you walk and I will follow all day.

lines.zh: 你手指上的糖霜，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I can see the frosting on your fingers clearly.

lines.zh: 我爬得再慢，也不会放弃这块。
lines.en: However slow I go, I won't give up this piece.

lines.zh: 壳撞到你的鞋尖，响了一声。
lines.en: My shell knocks your boot tip with a small sound.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，我整只缩进去了。
lines.en: One touch from you and I am entirely inside.

lines.zh: 黏液沾在你手上，洗得掉。
lines.en: Slime on your hand will wash off.

lines.zh: 壳很硬，你的脚趾会先疼。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your toe will hurt first.

lines.zh: 我被你推得滑了半尺。
lines.en: You push me and I slide half a foot.

lines.zh: 别踩，我壳里的肉很软。
lines.en: Do not step; the flesh inside my shell is soft.

lines.zh: 红白的壳蹭过你的裤脚。
lines.en: My red-white shell brushes your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 你退开，我这才把眼睛伸出来。
lines.en: You step away, and only then do my eyes come out.

lines.zh: 碰一下，我留下一点薄荷味。
lines.en: One bump and I leave a little mint behind.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你比我晃得厉害。
lines.en: We collide, and you wobble more than I do.

lines.zh: 他的壳纹和我一样，只是浅些。
lines.en: His shell pattern matches mine, only paler.

lines.zh: 两只蜗牛并排，黏液连成一条。
lines.en: Two snails side by side, our slime joins.

lines.zh: 我绕着他的壳转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle his shell half a turn.

lines.zh: 留兰香的亲戚，闻起来都差不多。
lines.en: Spearmint kin all smell much the same.

lines.zh: 卵埋在糖土里，一颗颗很小。
lines.en: The eggs go into candy soil, each one tiny.

lines.zh: 我们头对头，谁也不动。
lines.en: We face each other and neither moves.

lines.zh: 交配完，他先走了，比我快。
lines.en: Afterward he leaves first, faster than me.

lines.zh: 小蜗牛出来时，壳是透明的。
lines.en: When the little ones hatch, their shells are clear.

lines.zh: 糖土很软，正适合埋卵。
lines.en: The candy soil is soft, perfect for burying eggs.

lines.zh: 我把卵藏在叶子下面。
lines.en: I hide the eggs beneath a leaf.

lines.zh: 我用齿舌刮下一小块糖。
lines.en: I scrape off a small piece of candy with my tongue.

lines.zh: 捡来的糖屑，我都含在嘴里。
lines.en: Every crumb I find stays in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这块糖霜太硬，我推着走。
lines.en: This frosting is too hard; I push it along.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用身体顶着。
lines.en: I have no hands; I nudge with my body.

lines.zh: 壳缝里塞了一片糖纸。
lines.en: A candy wrapper is wedged in my shell.

lines.zh: 我咬住叶子，拖回壳里吃。
lines.en: I bite a leaf and drag it back into my shell.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的薄荷糖，归我了。
lines.en: The peppermint dropped on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 搬不动整块糖，只好舔一舔。
lines.en: I cannot move the whole block, so I lick it.

lines.zh: 我把小石子推开，腾出地方。
lines.en: I push a pebble aside to make room.

lines.zh: 收集糖屑，是我一天的活。
lines.en: Gathering crumbs is my whole day's work.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看你，又低头吃草。
lines.en: I look up at you, then go back to eating.

lines.zh: 我没有要追的东西，只有要躲的。
lines.en: I chase nothing; there are only things to avoid.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的糖草，我绕过去。
lines.en: You block my candy grass, so I go around.

lines.zh: 壳一缩，就是我的全部战术。
lines.en: Pulling in my shell is my entire strategy.

lines.zh: 二十五点生命，够我慢一点。
lines.en: Twenty-five points of life lets me go slow.

lines.zh: 我不想打，也打不动。
lines.en: I do not want to fight, and could not anyway.

lines.zh: 你走近，我先停住，再判断。
lines.en: As you near, I stop first, then decide.

lines.zh: 我把触角收短，表示不想惹事。
lines.en: I shorten my tentacles to show I mean no trouble.

lines.zh: 这片叶子归我，别的不争。
lines.en: This leaf is mine; I contest nothing else.

lines.zh: 危险过去，我才继续爬。
lines.en: Only after the danger passes do I crawl on.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，怕它落下来。
lines.en: I watch your foot, afraid it will come down.

lines.zh: 壳口对着地面，我准备好了。
lines.en: Shell mouth to the ground, I am ready.

lines.zh: 你一弯腰，我就缩成一颗糖。
lines.en: When you bend down, I curl into a piece of candy.

lines.zh: 我算着你的距离，一尺一尺。
lines.en: I measure your distance, foot by foot.

lines.zh: 黏液干了，我走得更慢。
lines.en: The slime dries and I go slower.

lines.zh: 这里没有石头，我只能靠壳。
lines.en: There is no stone here; I have only my shell.

lines.zh: 我往糖草深处挪，一点点。
lines.en: I inch deeper into the candy grass.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，看谁先。
lines.en: You stay still, I stay still; who moves first?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛缩回去，世界就暗了。
lines.en: My eyes retract, and the world goes dim.

lines.zh: 等你不看这边，我再出来。
lines.en: When you look away, I will come out again.

lines.zh: 我拿壳顶你，像顶一块石头。
lines.en: I butt you with my shell, like pushing a stone.

lines.zh: 这点力道，你大概只当是风。
lines.en: This force probably feels like wind to you.

lines.zh: 齿舌刮过你的手背，很轻。
lines.en: My tongue scrapes your hand, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的鞋带，不松口。
lines.en: I bite your shoelace and will not let go.

lines.zh: 我用齿舌舔你一下，算打了。
lines.en: I lick you once and call that a strike.

lines.zh: 壳一撞，我自己先退了半步。
lines.en: My shell hits and I am the one who backs off.

lines.zh: 我撞你的脚踝，然后缩起来。
lines.en: I bump your ankle, then tuck myself in.

lines.zh: 这不是打架，是我想过去。
lines.en: This is not a fight; I want to get past.

lines.zh: 黏液糊在你手上，算我赢。
lines.en: Slime on your hand; I count that as a win.

lines.zh: 我连草都咬不断，别说你。
lines.en: I cannot even bite through grass, let alone you.

lines.zh: 我从糖土里钻出来，壳还软。
lines.en: I push out of candy soil, my shell still soft.

lines.zh: 第一顿饭是脚边的糖草。
lines.en: My first meal is the candy grass at my feet.

lines.zh: 红白纹一层层长出来，像糖纸。
lines.en: The red-white rings grow in, like candy wrap.

lines.zh: 我身边有很多壳，都是空的。
lines.en: Many shells lie around me, all of them empty.

lines.zh: 糖果维度的风是甜的，我记住了。
lines.en: The wind of Candyland is sweet; I remember it.

lines.zh: 壳口朝上，我先把触角伸出去。
lines.en: Shell mouth up, I send my tentacles out first.

lines.zh: 我比一粒糖大不了多少。
lines.en: I am barely bigger than a single candy.

lines.zh: 兄弟姐妹爬散了，我慢慢跟。
lines.en: My siblings crawl away and I follow slowly.

lines.zh: 黏液第一次流出来，是凉的。
lines.en: The first slime I make comes out cool.

lines.zh: 我找了半天，才找到一片能吃的叶。
lines.en: I searched a long time for one edible leaf.

lines.zh: 壳被烤热，里面的糖开始化。
lines.en: My shell heats up and the sugar inside melts.

lines.zh: 壳先落地，弹了两下才停。
lines.en: My shell lands first and bounces twice.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳口，我的黏液浮起来。
lines.en: Water enters my shell and my slime floats up.

lines.zh: 壳被震开，红白碎片飞得很远。
lines.en: The blast splits my shell and red-white shards fly far.

lines.zh: 箭钉在壳上，裂口又宽了一点。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell and widens the crack.

lines.zh: 药水溅到壳上，冒出薄荷味的泡。
lines.en: Potion hits my shell and bubbles smell of mint.

lines.zh: 糖草吃完了，壳都轻了。
lines.en: The candy grass is gone and my shell feels light.

lines.zh: 雷打在壳上，我整只缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，壳还在打转。
lines.en: As I fall, my shell keeps spinning.
